test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given information carefully and answer the following questions.

Five coaching classes - P, Q, R, S and T, are located on five different floors 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5, but not necessarily in the same order. Each coaching class teaches only one subject among Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology and English, but not necessarily in the same order. The following information is also known:

Biology subject is taught in coaching class S, while English subject is not taught in coaching class Q.

Coaching class R is on the third floor, and Chemistry subject is taught in coaching class P.

Physics subject is taught in the coaching class located on the fifth floor.

English or Physics subject is not taught in the coaching class located on the third floor.

On the basis of the given information, tell on which floor Mathematics subject is taught?
solution:
**Given: **Five coaching classes P, Q, R, S, and T are located on five different floors, numbered 1 to 5. Each coaching class teaches only one subject out of Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Biology, and English.

1) Coaching Class R is on the third floor, and Chemistry is taught in Coaching Class P.

2) Biology is taught in Coaching Class S, while English is not taught in Coaching Class Q.

3) Neither English nor Physics is taught in the coaching class located on the third floor.

As English is not taught neither in Coaching Class Q nor on the third floor, therefore only coaching class left for English is T.

After positioning English, only possible coaching class left for Physics is Q.

After positioning Physics only one position is left in subjects, which will be occupied by the only subject left i.e. Mathematics.
